title: Finance starter
description: Rates, filings and accounting tools, plus prompts to summarise reports, check invoices, fill expense claims and analyse variances.

apps.name: Summarise this report
apps.prompt: Summarise this financial report or filing: revenue, gross margin, operating income, net income, cash flow, debt and guidance, each against the prior period with the % change. List the risks the report itself mentions. Use only figures from the page.

apps.name: Check an invoice
apps.prompt: Check the invoice on this page against my files (purchase orders, contracts) for {{ask: Supplier? | this supplier}}: amounts, quantities, unit prices, tax, payment terms and due date. List every mismatch.

apps.name: Fill an expense claim
apps.prompt: Fill the expense form on this page with these receipt details: {{ask: Receipt details (date, merchant, amount, category)?}} Show me what you will enter, and do not press submit.

apps.name: Variance analysis
apps.prompt: From the table on this page, calculate actual vs. budget variance (amount and %) for each line, flag anything over {{ask: Threshold? | 10%}}, and suggest likely explanations to check.

apps.name: Convert currency
apps.prompt: Convert {{ask: Amount and currencies? | 1,250 USD to EUR}} at today's rate. Show the rate, its source, and when it was quoted.

apps.name: Month-end checklist
apps.prompt: Create a month-end close checklist for the month of {{date}}: reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, intercompany, fixed assets and reporting, with an empty owner column.

apps.name: Explain a term
apps.prompt:
Explain this finance term or clause in plain words, with a short example using numbers:

{{selection}}
